text:
Alex (CEO): thanks for attending  follow-up thread for quick strategy Qs. keep them short and we'll answer live.
Jordan (Growth): need a one-liner for engineers evaluating us vs self-hosting.
Maya (Head of Product): try: "Don't rebuild inference infra: predictable latency, lower unit cost, and unified ops." Keep it <15 words.
Priya (Solutions): customers ask: which buyer owns the decision  infra team or app team?
Alex (CEO): typically app/ML teams start (PLG). infra/security join at Dedicated/Private decision points. Sales should loop platform owners early for compliance asks.
Ravi (CTO): tech nuance: emphasize we handle runtime complexity (KV cache, batching) so product teams avoid infra debt.
Theo (Research): competitors question: how do we talk about model quality vs model-owners? i.e., if a customer brings an SOTA model.
Maya (Head of Product): messaging: we don't compete on model research. We compete on serving: make your model predictable and cheaper to run.
Sam (VP Eng): roadmap: any immediate platform launches to highlight in next investor/customer comms?
Maya (Head of Product): short list: SLA doc (public), console token-cost drilldown, and model-variant routing beta. ETA 3-6 weeks.
Jordan (Growth): pricing ask: can we promise discounts for very high embedding traffic? Some enterprise pilots need it.
Alex (CEO): exploring a usage-tiered embeddings plan; pilots will be opt-in. No retroactive price changes for current customers.
Priya (Solutions): sales play: is it fair to say migration from Hosted->Dedicated is low-friction? Need confident language.
Ravi (CTO): yes  same API surface, stashable configs, and a migration checklist. Mention we provide SE support for migration.
Theo (Research): one more: how blunt should we be comparing latency numbers in public materials?
Alex (CEO): be transparent but contextualize. Share p95 numbers for typical configs, and include workload caveats. Avoid cherry-picking best-case benchmarks.
Maya (Head of Product): also highlight our fallback policies and cost-controls as a product story  customers love the guardrails during outages or cost spikes.
Sam (VP Eng): internal ask: which single metric should teams prioritize next quarter?
Maya (Head of Product): two metrics: 1) time-to-first-successful-query (TTFSQ) and 2) cost per 1M tokens for key customer segments.
Jordan (Growth): will update sales one-pager with the new lines and feature callouts.
allhands-bot: FYI: the post-all-hands survey is live in #announcements  please submit feedback. :point_up:
Alex (CEO): thanks all  if any unanswered Qs drop them here and tag the owner (PM/Eng) and we'll follow up.
